topic: Saturn's moon Mimas and its giant crater
script: One of Saturn's moons looks like a famous movie space station. Mimas has a giant crater called Herschel, about 130 kilometers wide. That is roughly a third of the moon's own width. Scientists think the impact that made it nearly broke Mimas apart. In 2024, scientists reported signs that Mimas may hide a young ocean under its ice. Mimas is only about 400 kilometers across.
